newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae, Fred Mac adequately funded through Q3.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae, Fred Mac adequately funded through Q3.

text.p: The Federal National Mortgage Association and Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp were adequately capitalized as of September 30, a Housing and Urban Development agency said Monday.

HUD's Office of Federal Housing Enterprise Oversight said that, as of September 30, it determined that Fannie Mae had a core capital of $12.267 billion, exceeding its minimum capital requirement of $11.120 billion by $1.147 billion.
The office said Freddie Mac had a core capital of $6.543 billion as of September 30, exceeding its minimum capital requirement of $6.279 billion by $264 million.
The office is required by Congress to determine at least quarterly the capital adequacy of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.
